name: air-worker
description: AirWorker 0.11.11-rc.4 source candidate: native Codex/Claude route enforcement and Hermes plugin compatibility, shared learning reviewer capacity 64; not installed.

interface.shortDescription: Run native Codex orchestration and independent Claude review through AirWorker.
interface.longDescription: AirWorker is the sole native executor, judge and learning runtime for Codex, Claude and Hermes adapters. Use native session, PLAN, orchestrate and semantic receipts; the separate signed llm-queue worker is an optional heavy-task capability.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the installed AirWorker kernel and the woody skill, not a direct Codex model call. Declare this session, read the product PLAN, then use air-worker orchestrate -product <root> -subagents 2 for two parallel Codex subagents and an independent Anthropic reviewer. Require native receipts and never use Codex App Server, direct claude -p, or a custom router.
